answer.approach: Build reusable component system as semantic markup first; use utilities for spacing, layout, type and state feedback. Include this evidence: @theme, @utility, focus-visible:, rounded, variant.
review_checklist: Test keyboard focus and narrow-screen layout.
Check meaningful alternative text and contrast when relevant.
